protocol.change: CreateArtifact uses top-level scalar mime_type; no nested metadata wrapper

limitations: Strict offline request fixtures do not prove remote upload or retention.
Real producer, downloaded bytes and independent acceptance remain required.
No Rust runtime, Cargo, DDL, workflow definition or permission changes.
Observable file stability is not an immutable filesystem snapshot or a hard stalled-I/O deadline.
Prior native upload receipts qualify only their exact previous source; this revision needs new execution and independent acceptance.
No complete uploader, filesystem or network security audit is claimed.

custody_and_redirects.file_custody: directory-relative no-follow open, inspected inode/fstat match, bounded reads and final identity checks
custody_and_redirects.redirect_policy: refuse all automatic redirects; original Twirp Authorization uses unredirected header; signed PUT remains credential-free
required_native_verification: real artifact upload and downloaded-byte validation
